title: A113258: Lean 4 formalization and finite certificates
description: Lean 4 source and finite certificates proving that the OEIS sequence A113258 has no perfect-power term after its fourth term. Includes certificate specifications, executable examples, build instructions, and an axiom audit. The final theorems use native_decide for finite checks and additionally trust the Lean compiler and runtime. This software release accompanies the paper Perfect powers in the OEIS sequence A113258.
